buildCommand: curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.22.0-stable.tar.xz -o flutter.tar.xz && tar -xf flutter.tar.xz && export PATH="$PATH:`pwd`/flutter/bin" && cd frontend_flutter && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
installCommand: echo 'Flutter will be installed during build'
